answer: Agents bond stake to a Semaphore identity commitment and prove membership while evaluating the epoch’s RLN polynomial. A scope-specific nullifier permits one message; two distinct valid messages in that scope enable Shamir-style interpolation to recover the identity secret, linking the proofs to the agent’s private key. The verifier can then slash the bonded collateral immediately. Labels such as anchor, willow, and pearl distinguish contexts without weakening the uniqueness check.
